outcome: Neonatal outcomes (birthweight, gestational age, adverse outcomes)
cohort: Women with PCOS undergoing frozen-embryo transfer (FET)
finding: In women with PCOS undergoing FET, BMI did not affect pregnancy or perinatal outcomes, except for an increased likelihood of cesarean delivery in overweight and obese women.
mod_finding: Overweight and obese women were more likely to deliver via cesarean section compared to women of normal weight.
